caseName: Commissioners of Road Improvement District No. 2 v. St. Louis Southwestern Railway Co.
caseNameFull: Commissioners of Road Improvement District No. 2, of Lafayette County, Arkansas v. St. Louis Southwestern Railway Company

opinions.text: October 25, 1920. Petition for a writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Eighth Circuit granted. Mr. Henry Moore, Jr., for petitioners. No appearance for respondent.
